newsitem.title: POLAND: Three NFI prospectuses reach Poland's KPW.
newsitem.headline: Three NFI prospectuses reach Poland's KPW.

text.p: Three of the 15 National Investment Funds (NFI) in Poland's mass privatisation scheme have submitted issue prospectuses to the Securities Commission (KPW), the KPW said in a statement on Thursday.

The treasury ministry, which oversees the NFI programme, has said all the funds would submit prospectuses to the KPW in the first 10 days of December and should reach the bourse in the first half of 1997.

Under the government programme, each fund was given control of about 33 medium-size companies. The 26 million Poles who bought a participation unit in the scheme will have the opportunity to exchange it for 15 shares, one in each fund.
The KPW also said five listed companies had submitted applications for new issues and seven non-public companies had been seeking permission for public trade.
